payload.blocks: Phase 2 review and land, and through it phases 3, 6 and 7 of plan 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner
payload.headline: Commit phase 2's finished but uncommitted work in the p02 worktree by hand, or let the lead redo it?

parts.cause: git refused the runner's scoped commit and its message was not kept (WAL cause commit-rejected only). Also, 9 of the paths were already dirty before the round, and the runner never commits pre-dirty paths, so a rerun in this worktree would commit nothing.

options.does: Run the git add + commit command recorded at the end of phase-02-argv-window.md Lead notes, from the main checkout outside any head, and answer with git's output if it fails
options.gain: Keeps 22 minutes of finished work; git prints the real refusal if there is one
options.harm: A commit outside the runner, without a runner provenance record
options.label: Commit by hand

options.cost: One more unit run, about 25 minutes
options.does: The lead creates a new worktree from main and reruns the unit; the p02 worktree stays as a reference
options.gain: No owner action; the runner commits with provenance
options.harm: Redoes about 20 minutes of worker time; the unknown git refusal may repeat
options.label: Lead reruns fresh

parts.recommendation: Commit by hand: the work is done and verified by the worker, and a hand commit also shows the git error the runner swallowed.

scope.allows: One commit of exactly those 32 paths on branch heads-operate-without-owner/p02
scope.forbids: Pushing, landing on main, or touching files outside those paths

parts.what: The phase 2 worker passed (steps 1-8, its cargo and node tests green) but the runner's commit failed, so 32 changed paths sit uncommitted in /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner-p02. A lead has no door that commits a worktree.

payload.blocks: Phase 2 being marked done (its step 9 check and two follow-ups)
payload.headline: Phase 2 needs three files outside the plan footprint and leaves 4 door-row allowance lines; how to close them?

parts.cause: Read from the worker's final report in unit run unit-run-1795576677937-017b4e0f. The in-scope reader fills session.verbs from the new table, so behaviour is correct today; the 4 lines cover imports with no door yet (bind, readAccountStateOverlay) or a missing seam-row entry.

options.cost: One backlog row; the item is about 100-200 lines later
options.does: Land phase 2 as is; open one backlog item for the engine's session.verbs removal, the bin/fgos.mjs can-i refusal and the 4 allowance lines
options.gain: Phase 2 lands now and phases 3, 6, 7 proceed
options.harm: Two places still carry session.verbs for a while; step 9 is not fully met
options.label: Follow-up item

options.cost: Planner pass plus one unit, about 1 hour
options.does: A planner adds the three files to the plan footprint; the lead runs a fix unit before landing
options.gain: Phase 2 is complete in one land
options.harm: Plan change and another unit before anything lands
options.label: Widen the footprint

parts.recommendation: Follow-up item: behaviour is correct now, and the leftovers are cleanup that need not block the next three phases.

scope.allows: Marking phase 2 done with the step 9 check recorded as partly met, and one new backlog item
scope.forbids: Editing the engine files or bin/fgos.mjs inside this plan

parts.what: The worker says the execution engine still writes and gates on session.verbs (packages/execution/engine/src/transport_round/session_attempt.rs and tests/transport_round.rs), and bin/fgos.mjs answers 'unknown verb' for fgos can-i outside a head. Both are outside the plan footprint. Step 9's rg check still finds 4 allowance lines in the door rows.
